title: The Value of PET-CT in Pleural Effusions
brief_summary: The investigators aim is to asses the diagnostic power of 18F-FDG PET-CT in discriminating malignant from nonmalignant causes in patients with a recurrent unilateral pleural effusion of unknown origin.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Thoracocentesis
* Chest X-ray
* CT scanning
* PET-CT scanning

Exclusion Criteria:

* Missing data
* Lung cancer
* Thoracic malignancies
study_population: All patients with a unilateral pleural effusion of unknown origin examined with the above
